judgment.notes: N003 supplies nonzero finite generation and the one-dimensional rational span used in S001. H001 supplies primality for the prime-power construction in S002; D006 verifies membership of each unit and its inverse. N003, N001 and N002 respectively supply the internal decomposition, complex independence and injectivity used in S004. All routine background conditions are available; there are no E/M applications.

S001 legitimately obtains a finite nonempty list of nonzero rational multiples of a. In S002 negative exponents define rational scalars since p is nonzero; the exponent differences in q_j a=p^(nu_j-nu)u_j b are nonnegative. A minimizing coefficient in S003 yields b in J by multiplication by an R-unit inverse, and the generator inclusions give J=Rb. S004 substitutes this equality into the supplied internal sum, proves R-independence using b nonzero and complex independence, and transports the basis through the injective map onto its image. Every output clause follows. All constructions and sums are finite; no limiting operations occur.
